notes.title: 7days Origins is participating in the Storyteller Festival!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275092/592ced1487c1607535880a9eb20625a5268bfa4a.jpg

Hello, Everyone! Long time no see :) 
We're thrilled to announce that 7Days Origins is participating in the Storytellers Festival. Blue Wednesday will be there too!

The Storyteller’s Festival begins at 9:00am 26/3/2023 (AEDT) or 2:00pm 25/3/2023 (PST), 
depending on your timezones.
Seven Days is participating in the festival for the first time! 
It will feature a bunch of narrative-rich games! 

We have also prepared a gameplay video to show. 
We would like to do a live broadcast later if we have time!

notes.title: Patch Notes #5
notes.content:
[New Feature]
- PS4 Controller(DualShock 4), Xbox Controller support added
- Keyboard input support added

[Bug fixes]
- If an exception occurs on loading the game data previously saved, it will be replaced with the latest auto-save data

Keyboard and Controller supports are now available!

You can play 7 days origin with keyboards and controllers from this patch!
The keys you can use is like below:

Keyboards

- Main Axis Input: W/A/S/D
- Sub Axis Input(Scroll): Arrows
- Submit: F/Space
- Escape: ESC

Controllers

- Main Axis Input: Left Stick
- Sub Axis Input(Scroll): Right Stick
- Submit: A (Xbox controller), X (PS controllers)
- Escape: B (Xbox controller), O (PS controllers)
- Menu hotkey: Menu (Xbox controller), Options (PS controllers)

Additional info for bug fixes

We've fixed the issue that occurs loading game data that previously saved. But if you have a similar symptom(such as the game window won't show up after pressing the "Continue" button), please follow the below steps:

- Restart your computer and launch Steam
- From the game's library page, select Manage > Properties
- Select the Local files tab and click the Verify integrity of game files... button
- Steam will verify the game's files (may take several minutes)
- If the problem has not been fixed, go to C:\Users\(user name)\AppData\LocalLow\Buff Studio Co, Ltd_\7Days Origins
- Delete the GameData.json file

If the problem was not fixed after following those steps, please contact us via help@buffstudio.com

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275092/60dff38695d568cbc79b639b856d284cad1f9cbf.gif

notes.title: Patch Notes #4
notes.content:
[BUG FIXES]
- Turkish localization issue fixed: Ending title localization has been corrected.
- Soft-lock error, which occurs after the pause menu displayed, has been fixed.
- UI rendering issue fixed: The escape menu will not be rendered behind the follower information panel.

notes.title: Patch Notes #3
notes.content:
[BUG FIXES]
- FPS drop has been fixed, which occurs after selecting the answer to Charon's question in the first chapter when you playing the game in Turkish.
- The data(such as characters likability) will be reset properly after watching the endings.

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
[BUG FIXES]
- [spoiler]Fixed an issue that the game stop after Hilde attacks Kirell in the 5th chapter has been fixed.[/spoiler]
- Fixed some UIs to render a correct font.

[UI/UX IMPROVEMENTS]
- The title text of chapter-end UI will be rendered in a single line.
- A popup message will be shown after saving data on a pause menu.
- A short delay has been added after closing the monologue popup and animation popup.

If you find any bugs, please don't hesitate to report them to help@buffstudio.com. Thank you :)
